summary: Seven household names, then the twist: Mixue, a Chinese ice cream and tea chain, has more locations than McDonald's. Taco Bell, Wendy's and Dunkin' all just miss.
reasons: Casual player finds the 7 Western giants, then runs out of lives on Taco Bell #18, Wendy's #22, Dunkin' #11, Chick-fil-A #38 and Tim Hortons #25, each with a rank to learn from.
Fun surprises: Mixue #1, Luckin Coffee #4 and Wallace #8, three Chinese chains most players have never heard of.
Meets the daily-list bar in this triage (casual 7, Blitz 29). Written by the builder (data agent), not an independent judge, so held at free-play, the scope the Oddball category was built for.
fixes: Each chain's count is from its own year (2021 to 2026); Dunkin' (12,700, 2021) and Krispy Kreme are the stalest near misses.
